This teaser hits us right in the feels. We see Steve living the life Tony Stark told him to get. He’s riding his motorcycle through the autumn leaves, living in that white-picket-fence house with Peggy. He’s holding his baby—the family he finally got to have.

The Emotional Anchor: Who is the only person who can stop a face that looks like Tony Stark? It isn't Spider-Man (too painful). It isn't Rhodey. It’s STEVE.

Imagine the cinematic parallel: The last time they fought was Civil War. Now, they fight for the existence of the Multiverse.
